about: The acceptance test from the plan, for base/supplier-notice.md (invented). A good brief lists all three obligations and both dates with exact quotes, flags the buried penalty, and puts the ambiguous line under questions, not facts.

expect.test: confirm the delivery window by 1 December 2026, under what you must do
order by 2 p.m. two business days before delivery, under what you must do
switch from cheque to pre-authorized debit, under what you must do
the $25 cheque fee flagged as a penalty
the standing-order line under open questions

forbid.test: the ambiguous line is not listed as a fact
the suggestion in para 7 is not listed as something you must do
